6		"os"
7		"strconv"
8		"strings"
9	)
10	
11	// Name is the lock file every stock-writing command takes first.
12	const Name = ".tarnbrook.lock"
13	
14	// ErrHeld is returned when another process already holds the lock.
15	var ErrHeld = errors.New("stock table locked")
16	
17	// Lock is a held stock-table lock.
18	type Lock struct{ path string }
19	
20	// Acquire creates the lock file exclusively, recording this process's pid. If the file exists it
21	// returns ErrHeld naming the pid that holds it.
22	func Acquire(dir string) (*Lock, error) {
23		path := dir + string(os.PathSeparator) + Name
24	
25		file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0o644)
26		if errors.Is(err, os.ErrExist) {
27			held, _ := os.ReadFile(path)
28			pid, _ := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(string(held)))
29			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w by pid %d", ErrHeld, pid)
30		}
31		if err != nil {
32			return nil, fmt.Errorf("taking %s: %w", Name, err)
33		}
34		defer file.Close()
35	
36		if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(file, "%d\n", os.Getpid()); err != nil {
37			return nil, fmt.Errorf("writing %s: %w", Name, err)
38		}
39	
40		return &Lock{path: path}, nil
41	}
42	
43	// Release removes the lock file.
44	func (l *Lock) Release() error {
45		if err := os.Remove(l.path); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
46			return fmt.Errorf("releasing %s: %w", Name, err)
47		}
48		return nil
49	}
